english.name: Timber!!
english.description: Chop down your first tree.

schinese.name: 木材！！
schinese.description: 砍倒第一棵树。

english.name: No Hobo
english.description: Build a house suitable enough for your first town NPC, such as the guide, to move into.

schinese.name: 有家可归
schinese.description: 建造一栋足够大的房屋，让第一个城镇NPC（如向导）住进来。

english.name: Stop! Hammer Time!
english.description: Obtain your first hammer via crafting or otherwise.

schinese.name: 停！锤子时间到！
schinese.description: 通过制作或其他方式获得第一把锤子。

english.name: Ooo! Shiny!
english.description: Mine your first nugget of ore with a pickaxe.

schinese.name: 哦！亮闪闪！
schinese.description: 用镐开采第一块矿石。

english.name: Heart Breaker
english.description: Discover and smash your first heart crystal underground.

schinese.name: 伤心者
schinese.description: 首次在地下发现并粉碎水晶之心。

english.name: Heavy Metal
english.description: Obtain an anvil made from iron or lead.

schinese.name: 重金属
schinese.description: 获得由铁或铅制成的砧子。

english.name: I Am Loot!
english.description: Discover a golden chest underground and take a peek at its contents.

schinese.name: 战利品！
schinese.description: 在地下找到一个金宝箱并看看里面有什么。

english.name: Star Power
english.description: Craft a mana crystal out of fallen stars, and consume it.

schinese.name: 星之力
schinese.description: 使用坠落之星制作魔力水晶并使用它。

english.name: Hold on Tight!
english.description: Equip your first grappling hook.

schinese.name: 抓紧！
schinese.description: 首次装备钩爪。

english.name: Eye on You
english.description: Defeat the Eye of Cthulhu, an ocular menace who only appears at night.

schinese.name: 盯着你
schinese.description: 打败克苏鲁之眼，它是只在夜间出没的危险眼球怪。

english.name: Smashing, Poppet!
english.description: Using explosives or your trusty hammer, smash a Shadow Orb or Crimson Heart in the evil parts of your world.

schinese.name: 碎得漂亮，小乖乖！
schinese.description: 使用炸药或可靠的锤子，在世界的邪恶地带中粉碎暗影珠或猩红之心。

english.name: Worm Fodder
english.description: Defeat the Eater of Worlds, a massive worm whom dwells in the corruption.

schinese.name: 虫粮
schinese.description: 打败世界吞噬怪，它是居住在腐化之地的巨虫。

english.name: Mastermind
english.description: Defeat the Brain of Cthulhu, an enourmous demon brain which haunts the creeping crimson.

schinese.name: 最强大脑
schinese.description: 打败克苏鲁之脑，它是出没在让人毛骨悚然的猩红之地的巨大恶魔大脑。

english.name: Where's My Honey?
english.description: Discover a large bee's hive deep in the jungle.

schinese.name: 我的甜甜在哪儿？
schinese.description: 发现丛林深处的巨蜂蜂巢。

english.name: Sting Operation
english.description: Defeat the Queen Bee, the matriarch of the jungle hives.

schinese.name: 蜇刺行动
schinese.description: 打败蜂王，它是统治丛林蜂巢的女王。

english.name: Boned
english.description: Defeat Skeletron, the cursed guardian of the dungeon.

schinese.name: 粉身碎骨
schinese.description: 打败骷髅王，它是被诅咒的地牢守卫。

english.name: Dungeon Heist
english.description: Steal a key from the dungeon's undead denizens, and unlock one of their precious golden chests.

schinese.name: 地牢大劫案
schinese.description: 从地牢的亡灵居民处偷取钥匙，并打开一个它们的宝贵金宝箱。

english.name: It's Getting Hot in Here
english.description: Spelunk deep enough to reach the molten underworld.

schinese.name: 越来越热
schinese.description: 深入洞穴探险，到达熔火地狱。

english.name: Miner for Fire
english.description: Craft a molten pickaxe using the hottest of materials.

schinese.name: 烈焰矿工
schinese.description: 使用最热的材料制作熔岩镐。

english.name: Still Hungry
english.description: Defeat the Wall of Flesh, the master and core of the world who arises after a great, burning sacrifice.

schinese.name: 野心依旧
schinese.description: 打败血肉墙，它是世界的主宰与核心，会在伟大的燃烧献祭后出现。

english.name: It's Hard!
english.description: Unleash the ancient spirits of light and darkness across your world, enabling much stronger foes and showering the world with dazzling treasures (and rainbows!).

schinese.name: 举步维艰！
schinese.description: 在你的世界里释放古老的光明与黑暗之魂，让更强大的敌人出现，并用耀眼夺目的宝藏（和彩虹！）洗礼世界。

english.name: Begone, Evil!
english.description: Smash a demon or crimson altar with a powerful, holy hammer.

schinese.name: 滚开，恶魔！
schinese.description: 用强大而神圣的锤子砸碎恶魔或猩红祭坛。

english.name: Extra Shiny!
english.description: Mine a powerful ore that has been newly blessed upon your world.

schinese.name: 光彩夺目！
schinese.description: 开采你的世界新获赐的强大矿石。

english.name: Head in the Clouds
english.description: Equip a pair of wings.

schinese.name: 冲上云霄
schinese.description: 装备一对翅膀。

english.name: Like a Boss
english.description: Obtain a boss-summoning item.

schinese.name: 霸气侧漏
schinese.description: 获得召唤Boss的物品。

english.name: Buckets of Bolts
english.description: Defeat the three nocturnal mechanical menaces: the Twins, the Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime.

schinese.name: 万矢齐发
schinese.description: 打败三个夜间出没的危险机械怪物：双子魔眼、毁灭者和机械骷髅王。

english.name: Drax Attax
english.description: Craft a drax or pickaxe axe using hallowed bars, and the souls of the three mechanical bosses.

schinese.name: 斧钻战队
schinese.description: 用神圣锭和三个机械Boss的灵魂制作斧钻或镐斧。

english.name: Photosynthesis
english.description: Mine chlorophyte, an organic ore found deep among the thickest of flora.

schinese.name: 光合作用
schinese.description: 开采叶绿矿石，一种深藏在最稠密的植物中的有机矿石。

english.name: Get a Life
english.description: Consume a life fruit, which grows in the thick of subterranean jungle grass.

schinese.name: 重获新生
schinese.description: 吃一个生命果，这种果子长在茂密的地下丛林草地中。

english.name: The Great Southern Plantkill
english.description: Defeat Plantera, the overgrown monstrosity of the jungle's depths.

schinese.name: 大南方植物终结者
schinese.description: 打败世纪之花，它是蔓生在丛林深处的畸形怪花。

english.name: Temple Raider
english.description: Breach the impenetrable walls of the jungle temple.

schinese.name: 神庙丽影
schinese.description: 攻破丛林神庙坚不可摧的墙。

english.name: Lihzahrdian Idol
english.description: Defeat Golem, the stone-faced ritualistic idol of the lihzahrd tribe.

schinese.name: 丛林蜥蜴之神
schinese.description: 打败石巨人，它是丛林蜥蜴部落的石脸祭祀神像。

english.name: Robbing the Grave
english.description: Obtain a rare treasure from a difficult monster in the dungeon.

schinese.name: 盗墓
schinese.description: 从难对付的地牢怪兽那儿获得稀世珍宝。

english.name: Big Booty
english.description: Unlock one of the dungeon's large, mysterious chests with a special key.

schinese.name: 丰厚战利品
schinese.description: 用一把特别的钥匙打开地牢中的其中一个神秘大宝箱。

english.name: Fish Out of Water
english.description: Defeat Duke Fishron, mutant terror of the sea.

schinese.name: 离水之鱼
schinese.description: 打败猪龙鱼公爵，他是大海中的变异怪兽。

english.name: Obsessive Devotion
english.description: Defeat the Ancient Cultist, fanatical leader of the dungeon coven.

schinese.name: 虔诚信仰
schinese.description: 打败远古邪教徒，他是地牢巫团的狂热首领。

english.name: Star Destroyer
english.description: Defeat the four celestial towers of the moon.

schinese.name: 歼星者
schinese.description: 打败四个月亮天界柱。

english.name: Champion of Terraria
english.description: Defeat the Moon Lord.

schinese.name: 泰拉瑞亚斗士
schinese.description: 打败月亮领主。

english.name: Bloodbath
english.description: Survive a blood moon, a nocturnal event where the rivers run red and monsters swarm aplenty.

schinese.name: 大屠杀
schinese.description: 活着度过血月，在这一夜间事件中，河流会泛红，怪物蜂拥而至。

english.name: Slippery Shinobi
english.description: Defeat King Slime, the lord of all things slimy.

schinese.name: 黏滑忍者
schinese.description: 打败史莱姆王，它是所有黏滑生物的首领。

english.name: Goblin Punter
english.description: Triumph over a goblin invasion, a ragtag regiment of crude, barbaric, pointy-eared warriors and their shadowflame sorcerers.

schinese.name: 哥布林草民
schinese.description: 击败哥布林入侵，它们是一群低贱、野蛮、粗暴的尖耳朵战士和暗影焰巫士。

english.name: Walk the Plank
english.description: Triumph over a pirate invasion, a group of pillagers from the sea out for your booty... and your life!

schinese.name: 稳走跳板
schinese.description: 击败海盗入侵，这群来自海上的劫匪不仅要抢你的战利品……还要你的命！

english.name: Kill the Sun
english.description: Survive a solar eclipse, a day darker than night filled with creatures of horror.

schinese.name: 杀死太阳
schinese.description: 活着度过日食，这是比黑夜还黑暗的白天，到处都是恐怖生物。

english.name: Do You Want to Slay a Snowman?
english.description: Triumph over the frost legion, a festive family of maniacal snowman mobsters.

schinese.name: 想要杀死雪人吗？
schinese.description: 征服雪人军团，这是疯狂雪人暴徒的欢乐家族。

english.name: Tin-Foil Hatter
english.description: Triumph over a martian invasion, when beings from out of this world come to scramble your brains and probe you in uncomfortable places.

schinese.name: 锡箔帽商
schinese.description: 击败火星人入侵，在这事件里不属于这个世界的生物会扰乱你的心神并窥探你的隐私。

english.name: Baleful Harvest
english.description: Reach the 15th wave of a pumpkin moon, where evil lurks among the autumn harvest.

schinese.name: 邪恶丰收
schinese.description: 在南瓜月中打到第15波，恶魔潜伏在金秋丰收之中。

english.name: Ice Scream
english.description: Reach the 15th wave of a frost moon, where the festive season quickly degrades into madness.

schinese.name: 寒冰尖啸
schinese.description: 在霜月里打到第15波，节日迅速沦为疯狂暴动。

english.name: Sticky Situation
english.description: Survive the slime rain, where gelatinous organisms fall from the sky in droves.

schinese.name: 黏黏糊糊
schinese.description: 在史莱姆雨中活下来，在此期间明胶生物会成群结队地从天而降。

english.name: Real Estate Agent
english.description: Have all possible town NPCs living in your world.

schinese.name: 房产中介
schinese.description: 让所有可能的城镇NPC都生活在你的世界中。

english.name: Not the Bees!
english.description: Fire a Bee Gun while wearing a full set of Bee Armor.

schinese.name: 不要蜜蜂！
schinese.description: 穿着一整套蜜蜂盔甲时使用蜜蜂枪射击。

english.name: Jeepers Creepers
english.description: Stumble into a spider cavern in the underground.

schinese.name: 毛骨悚然
schinese.description: 在地下摸进蜘蛛洞。

english.name: Funkytown
english.description: Build or encounter a glowing mushroom field above the surface.

schinese.name: 时髦小镇
schinese.description: 打造或发现地表上的发光蘑菇地。

english.name: Into Orbit
english.description: You can only go down from here!

schinese.name: 进入轨道
schinese.description: 在这儿你只能往下走！

english.name: Rock Bottom
english.description: The only way is up!

schinese.name: 最底层
schinese.description: 唯一的出路是向上！

english.name: Mecha Mayhem
english.description: Do battle against the Twins, the Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime simultaneously and emerge victorious.

schinese.name: 机甲混战
schinese.description: 同时与双子魔眼、毁灭者和机械骷髅王战斗并获胜。

english.name: Gelatin World Tour
english.description: Defeat every type of slime there is!

schinese.name: 明胶世界之旅
schinese.description: 打败每一种史莱姆！

english.name: Fashion Statement
english.description: Equip armor or vanity clothing in all three social slots.

schinese.name: 时尚宣言
schinese.description: 在全部三个社交盔甲栏中都装备上盔甲或时装服饰。

english.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
english.description: Defeat an enemy by running it over with a minecart.

schinese.name: 开车谋杀
schinese.description: 通过矿车碾压来打败敌人。

english.name: Bulldozer
english.description: Destroy a total of 10,000 tiles.

schinese.name: 推土机
schinese.description: 共破坏10,000个图格。

english.name: There are Some Who Call Him...
english.description: Kill Tim.

schinese.name: 有人要杀他……
schinese.description: 杀死蒂姆。

english.name: Deceiver of Fools
english.description: Kill a nymph.

schinese.name: 傻瓜骗子
schinese.description: 杀死宁芙。

english.name: Sword of the Hero
english.description: Obtain a Terra Blade, forged from the finest blades of light and darkness.

schinese.name: 英雄之剑
schinese.description: 获得泰拉刃，这是用极品光明刃与极品黑暗刃锻造而成的。

english.name: Lucky Break
english.description: Survive a long fall with just a sliver of health remaining.

schinese.name: 时来运转
schinese.description: 活着从高处跌落并且只剩下一丁点生命值。

english.name: Throwing Lines
english.description: Throw a yoyo.

schinese.name: 扔绳子
schinese.description: 投掷悠悠球。

english.name: Dye Hard
english.description: Equip a dye in every possible dye slot.

schinese.name: 处处遍染
schinese.description: 在每个可能的染料栏中都装备染料。

english.name: Sick Throw
english.description: Obtain the Terrarian.

schinese.name: 非凡投掷
schinese.description: 获得泰拉悠悠球。

english.name: The Frequent Flyer
english.description: Spend over 1 gold being treated by the nurse.

schinese.name: 常旅客
schinese.description: 在接受护士的治疗上花费超过1个金币。

english.name: The Cavalry
english.description: Equip a mount.

schinese.name: 骑兵
schinese.description: 装备坐骑。

english.name: Completely Awesome
english.description: Obtain a minishark.

schinese.name: 妙不可言
schinese.description: 获得一把迷你鲨。

english.name: Til Death...
english.description: Kill the groom.

schinese.name: 至死不渝……
schinese.description: 杀死僵尸新郎。

english.name: Archaeologist
english.description: Kill Doctor Bones.

schinese.name: 考古学家
schinese.description: 杀死骷髅博士。

english.name: Pretty in Pink
english.description: Kill pinky.

schinese.name: 粉红佳人
schinese.description: 杀死粉史莱姆。

english.name: Rainbows and Unicorns
english.description: Fire a rainbow gun while riding on a unicorn.

schinese.name: 彩虹和独角兽
schinese.description: 骑着独角兽时用彩虹枪射击。

english.name: You and What Army?
english.description: Command nine summoned minions simultaneously.

schinese.name: 你和哪路神仙啊？
schinese.description: 同时控制九个召唤仆从。

english.name: Prismancer
english.description: Obtain a rainbow rod.

schinese.name: 七彩法师
schinese.description: 获得一根彩虹魔杖。

english.name: It Can Talk?!
english.description: Build a house in a mushroom biome and have the Truffle move in.

schinese.name: 它能说话？！
schinese.description: 在蘑菇群落里建造一栋房屋，并让松露人住进来。

english.name: Watch Your Step!
english.description: Become a victim to a nasty underground trap.

schinese.name: 当心脚下！
schinese.description: 成为险恶地下陷阱的受害者。

english.name: Marathon Medalist
english.description: Travel a total of 26.2 miles on foot.

schinese.name: 马拉松奖牌得主
schinese.description: 总共步行26.2英里。

english.name: Glorious Golden Pole
english.description: Obtain a golden fishing rod.

schinese.name: 荣耀金竿
schinese.description: 获得一根金钓竿。

english.name: Servant-in-Training
english.description: Complete your 1st quest for the angler.

schinese.name: 受训仆人
schinese.description: 完成第1个渔夫任务。

english.name: Good Little Slave
english.description: Complete your 10th quest for the angler.

schinese.name: 三好小奴隶
schinese.description: 完成10个渔夫任务。

english.name: Trout Monkey
english.description: Complete your 25th quest for the angler.

schinese.name: 顽皮鳟鱼
schinese.description: 完成25个渔夫任务。

english.name: Fast and Fishious
english.description: Complete your 50th quest for the angler.

schinese.name: 游刃有鱼
schinese.description: 完成50个渔夫任务。

english.name: Supreme Helper Minion!
english.description: Complete a grand total of 200 quests for the angler.

schinese.name: 终极得力仆从！
schinese.description: 共完成200个渔夫任务。

english.name: Topped Off
english.description: Attain maximum health and mana possible without accessories or buffs.

schinese.name: 满满当当
schinese.description: 在没有配饰或增益的情况下达成最大可能生命值和魔力值。

english.name: Slayer of Worlds
english.description: Defeat every boss in Terraria.

schinese.name: 世界杀手
schinese.description: 打败泰拉瑞亚中的每一个Boss。

english.name: You Can Do It!
english.description: Survive your character's first full night.

schinese.name: 你能行！
schinese.description: 让你的人物安然度过第一晚。

english.name: Matching Attire
english.description: Equip armor in all three armor slots: head, chest, and feet.

schinese.name: 搭配服装
schinese.description: 在全部三个盔甲栏（头部、胸部和腿部）中装备盔甲。

english.name: Benched
english.description: Craft your first work bench.

schinese.name: 准备到位
schinese.description: 制作你的第一个工作台。

english.name: Fae Flayer
english.description: Defeat the Empress of Light, responsible for all those flashy lights and glitter.

schinese.name: 仙灵鞭挞者
schinese.description: 打败光之女皇，她是所有闪亮光辉之源。

english.name: Just Desserts
english.description: Defeat Queen Slime, giving the coup-de-grace to the sovereign of all that jiggles.

schinese.name: 甜点而已
schinese.description: 打败史莱姆皇后，帮所有摇晃之物的君主解脱。

english.name: Don't Dread on Me
english.description: Defeat the Dreadnautilus, murderous mollusk lurking beneath the surface of the sanguine seas.

schinese.name: 不要怕我
schinese.description: 打败恐惧鹦鹉螺，它是潜伏在血染海面之下的残忍软体动物。

english.name: Hero of Etheria
english.description: Repel the strongest forces the Old One's Army can muster.

schinese.name: 埃特尼亚的英雄
schinese.description: 击退撒旦军队可以召集的最强部队。

english.name: Infinity +1 Sword
english.description: Obtain the Zenith, the culmination of a journey forged into the ultimate sword.

schinese.name: 无限+1之剑
schinese.description: 获得天顶剑，这是由旅程的巅峰时刻凝聚而成的终极宝剑。

english.name: Boots of the Hero
english.description: Obtain the Terraspark Boots, forged from the finest boots of fire and ice.

schinese.name: 英雄之靴
schinese.description: 获得泰拉闪耀靴，这是用极品火靴与极品冰靴铸造而成的。

english.name: A Rather Blustery Day
english.description: Fly a kite on a windy day.

schinese.name: 狂风大作的一天
schinese.description: 在大风天放风筝。

english.name: Quiet Neighborhood
english.description: Enter a misty graveyard filled with the surly dead.

schinese.name: 安静的邻里
schinese.description: 进入笼罩着薄雾的墓地，墓地中到处都是粗鲁无礼的死人。

english.name: Hot Reels!
english.description: Drop a lure in a pool of lava for a pre-fried haul!

schinese.name: 火热渔线轮！
schinese.description: 将诱饵投入熔岩池，钓点预炸过的鱼！

english.name: Heliophobia
english.description: Trick a gnome into turning into stone!

schinese.name: 日光恐惧症
schinese.description: 诱使侏儒变成石头！

english.name: Leading Landlord
english.description: Meet with a tenant who's as happy as they possibly can be!

schinese.name: 杰出房东
schinese.description: 见一位极度快乐的房客！

english.name: Feeling Petty
english.description: Deliver headpats to the town pet.

schinese.name: 感觉受宠
schinese.description: 去拍拍城镇宠物的脑袋。

english.name: Hey! Listen!
english.description: Encounter a fairy.

schinese.name: 嘿！听着！
schinese.description: 遇到仙灵。

english.name: Jolly Jamboree
english.description: What you're celebrating doesn't matter, just throw a party already!

schinese.name: 欢乐盛会
schinese.description: 在庆祝什么不重要，只要办派对就好啦！

english.name: Dead Men Tell No Tales
english.description: You were so preoccupied with whether or not you could open the chest that you didn't stop to think if you should.

schinese.name: 死人不会告密
schinese.description: 你一心在琢磨能否打开宝箱，却没有想过是否应该打开宝箱。

english.name: An Eye For An Eye
english.description: Defeat Deerclops, the chilly one-eyed monstrosity from a foreign land.

schinese.name: 以眼还眼
schinese.description: 打败独眼巨鹿，它是来自异地的阴冷独眼怪物。

english.name: Feast of Midas
english.description: Obtain Golden Delight, the highest quality meal made from the highest quality . . . ingredients.

schinese.name: 迈达斯盛宴
schinese.description: 获得金美味，这是用最高品质的……食材制成的最高品质的餐点。

english.name: Unusual Survival Strategies
english.description: Delay death from drowning by drinking water. It doesn't make much sense, but you did what you had to do.

schinese.name: 不寻常的生存策略
schinese.description: 通过喝水来延缓溺亡。虽然没什么意义，但你做了必须做的事。

english.name: Black Mirror
english.description: Obtain the Cell Phone. You'll never leave home without it again.

schinese.name: 黑镜
schinese.description: 获得手机。你以后再也不会不带它就出门。

english.name: Ankhumulation Complete
english.description: Obtain the Ankh Shield, the finest protection from unpleasant maladies and ailments.

schinese.name: 十字章收集完成
schinese.description: 获得十字章护盾，这是对抗烦人疾病的最佳防护。

english.name: Torch God
english.description: Invoked the wrath of the God of Torches, and survived long enough to earn its blessing.

schinese.name: 火把神
schinese.description: 引发了火把神的愤怒，并存活足够长时间来获得它的恩宠。

english.name: A Rare Realm
english.description: Some very special seeds can lead to unique and rewarding experiences. Can you find one?

schinese.name: 稀有国度
schinese.description: 一些非常特殊的种子可以带来独特而有收获的体验。你能找到其中之一吗？

english.name: The Great Slime Mitosis
english.description: Find all of the Slime Pets and have them move in!

schinese.name: 史莱姆大分裂
schinese.description: 找到所有史莱姆宠物并让它们搬进来！

english.name: A Shimmer In The Dark
english.description: Shimmer an item into another item. What other transmutations can you find?

schinese.name: 暗中微光
schinese.description: 用微光将一个物品变成另一个物品。你还能找到哪些其他变化？

english.name: And Good Riddance!
english.description: Completely purify all Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow from your world, until the Dryad is satisfied!

schinese.name: 终于解脱了！
schinese.description: 彻底净化世界中所有的腐化、猩红和神圣，直到树妖满意为止！

english.name: To Infinity... and Beyond!
english.description: Fly a Kwad Racer into outer space.

schinese.name: 飞向宇宙，浩瀚无垠！
schinese.description: 将四轴竞速无人机飞进外太空。

english.name: Book Worm
english.description: Catalogue every creature in the world.

schinese.name: 书虫
schinese.description: 将世界中的所有生物登记在册。

english.name: Boulder Lord
english.description: Prove your worth against the Moon Lord's worst.

schinese.name: 巨石领主
schinese.description: 通过对阵最可怕的月亮领主来证明你的价值。

english.name: Queen Machine
english.description: Defeated the combined form of the 3 mechanical giants.

schinese.name: 机器女王
schinese.description: 打败3只机械巨怪的组合形态。

english.name: Rollin’ In Your Grave
english.description: Take a ride in your final resting place.

schinese.name: 陵墓飙车
schinese.description: 在你的最终安息之地兜风。

english.name: Fear The Sun
english.description: Dawn the garb of a vampire and get a sunburn.

schinese.name: 畏惧太阳
schinese.description: 穿上吸血鬼的装束并被太阳灼伤。

english.name: It’s Shaling Outside
english.description: Survive the dreaded rain of boulders.

schinese.name: 石如雨下
schinese.description: 活过可怕的巨石雨。

english.name: Extra Life
english.description: Die as a hardcore character and survive to tell the tale.

schinese.name: 劫后余生
schinese.description: 作为一个硬核角色死去并活着讲述这段传奇。

english.name: Grave Mistake
english.description: “Accidentally” kill a friend with your tombstone.

schinese.name: 葬送失误
schinese.description: 用你的墓石“意外”击杀一个朋友。

english.name: Spicy Licks
english.description: Jam out on a six stringed instrument.

schinese.name: 热辣旋律
schinese.description: 在六弦乐器上演奏。

english.name: Organized Chaos
english.description: Find the ultra rare Rod of Discord.

schinese.name: 有序混乱
schinese.description: 发现超级稀有的混沌传送杖。

english.name: On Fleek
english.description: Spot the sun on a “cool” day.

schinese.name: 完美至极
schinese.description: 在“炫酷”的一天看到太阳。

english.name: Fortune Favors the Bould
english.description: Discover a friendly boulder.

schinese.name: 机遇偏爱“石”力
schinese.description: 发现一块友好的巨石。

english.name: Training Day
english.description: Get your villagers fully combat ready.

schinese.name: 训练日
schinese.description: 让你的城镇居民做好充分的战斗准备。

english.name: Mini-Me
english.description: Become a Moon Lord impersonator.

schinese.name: 迷你自我
schinese.description: 成为月亮领主模仿者。

english.name: Terrarist
english.description: Scare your villagers with a stink bug sword.

schinese.name: 泰拉恐怖分子
schinese.description: 用一把臭虫之剑恐吓你的城镇居民。

english.name: New Digs
english.description: Give any villager a new look.

schinese.name: 新行头
schinese.description: 给予任意城镇居民一身新装束。

english.name: My People Need Me
english.description: Embark on a one way trip into outer space.

schinese.name: 我的子民需要我
schinese.description: 踏上一趟通往外太空的单程之旅。

english.name: Going Oldschool
english.description: Bring back the original title screen.

schinese.name: 致敬经典
schinese.description: 换回最初的标题屏幕。

english.name: Sea You Later
english.description: Craft the final upgrade to the Cell Phone.

schinese.name: 关怀“贝”至
schinese.description: 制作手机的终极升级物。

english.name: Trash Compactor
english.description: Research 50% of all items in Journey Mode.

schinese.name: 垃圾压缩机
schinese.description: 研究旅行模式中全部物品的50%。

english.name: Conservationist
english.description: Support sustainable logging by planting 100 acorns.

schinese.name: 环保主义者
schinese.description: 通过种下100颗橡实来支持可持续砍伐。

english.name: Interdimensional Recycling
english.description: Give the Dryad a can of Joja Cola.

schinese.name: 跨维度回收
schinese.description: 给予树妖一罐Joja可乐。
